# 8x8

Nobody publishes a machine-readable description of this API, so there is no pack for it
and no operation in this directory can be called. What follows is the vendor's own
documentation index, kept as context. **Nothing here is an endpoint this directory
vouches for**: read it, then read their reference.

- API: `https://api.8x8.com`
- Credential: `8X8_TOKEN` (oauth)

      <!--
        d360-article Custom Element host-config.
        Set BEFORE the lazy stub so the CE bundle picks it up at bootstrap.
        `mermaidWrapAsImage: true` makes mermaid diagrams render as
        `<img data:image/svg+xml;…>` instead of inline `<svg>`. Site V2's
        host directive `appImageViewer` (viewerjs) then treats the diagram
        like an uploaded image — clicking opens the same lightbox.

        `tableFilterSortEnabledCheck` gates the table sort/filter header
        controls on the 'Table Sort & Filter' article setting. The CE reads
        this config object once at bundle load — before project metadata is
        available — so the closure reads the late-bound
        `__D360_TABLE_FILTER_SORT_ENABLED__` global (set by ProjectService
        from projectSetting.documentationSetting.articleContentSettings) at
        article-render time instead of capturing a value here.
      -->
      <script>
            window.__D360_ARTICLE_CONFIG__ = {
                  mermaidWrapAsImage: true,
                  tableFilterSortEnabledCheck: function () {
                        return window.__D360_TABLE_FILTER_SORT_ENABLED__ === true;
                  },
            };
      </script>
      <!--
        D360_ARTICLE_CDN_INJECT marker.
        The Site V2 SSR pipeline (kb-site-angular-universal.module.ts)
        string-replaces this exact marker with a <script> tag that sets
        `window.__D360_ARTICLE_CDN__ = "${EDITOR360_URL}d360-article-element/main.js"`
        BEFORE the page is sent to the browser. The lazy stub below then
        picks up that global and fetches the CE bundle from the editor360
        CDN (same-origin localhost:5001 in dev, cdn.<env>.document360.net
        in qa/dev/staging/prod). If the marker is somehow not replaced
        (e.g. development without SSR pre-processing), the lazy stub
        falls back to the same-origin `/d360-article-ce/main.js` copied
        in by the gulp `copy-d360-article-ce` task.
      -->
      <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.us.document360.io" crossorigin><script>window.__D360_ARTICLE_CDN__ = "https://cdn.us.document360.io/static/mfe/editor360/d360-article-element/main.js";</script>
      <!--
        d360-article Custom Element lazy loader.
        Watches the DOM for a <d360-article> element and fetches the CE
        bundle on demand. Pages without an article (login, home, etc.)
        pay zero bytes.

        URL resolution (in priority order):
          1. window.__D360_ARTICLE_CDN__ — runtime override; set this from
             environment config (or any inline script BEFORE this stub) to
             point at the versioned CDN URL.
          2. Default `/d360-article-ce/main.js` — same-origin. The CE bundle
             is copied into Site V2's served output by the gulp
             `copy-d360-article-ce` task (see gulpfile.js + the
             `build:env:step3` script in package.json), which runs for BOTH
             local dev (`build:ssr-local`) and production (`build`). The
             namespace prefix `/d360-article-ce/` avoids colliding with
             Site V2's own root-level main.js / polyfills.js bundle names.

        SSR-safe: this <script> is preserved verbatim in the SSR output;
        Angular Universal does NOT execute inline scripts during render.
        The CE upgrade only fires in the browser. Article HTML reaches the
        CE via the `[attr.html]` attribute binding on <d360-article>
        (Angular serialises it as a real `html="..."` HTML attribute in
        the SSR output, which the CE wrapper's attributeChangedCallback
        picks up on upgrade).
      -->
      <script>
            (function () {
                  var loaded = false;
                  function load() {
                        if (loaded) return;
                        loaded = true;
                        // Resolve CE_URL HERE (not at IIFE invocation) so a value
                        // set by a LATER inline-script — e.g. the SSR-injected
                        // <script> for <!-- D360_ARTICLE_CDN_INJECT --> above us
                        // (executes first in head, so already set), or any future
                        // consumer that mounts main.ts before lazy-stub — is
                        // picked up. Defense-in-depth: keeps the stub safe even
                        // if the host changes the assignment timing.
                        var CE_URL = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.__D360_ARTICLE_CDN__) || '/d360-article-ce/main.js';
                        // Polyfills (zone.js etc.) required by the CE bundle.
                        // Load before main so the CE bootstrap finds them ready.
                        var p = document.createElement('script');
                        p.src = CE_URL.replace(/main\.js$/, 'polyfills.js');
                        p.type = 'module';
                        p.defer = true;
                        document.head.appendChild(p);
                        var s = document.createElement('script');
                        s.src = CE_URL;
                        s.type = 'module';
                        s.defer = true;
                        document.head.appendChild(s);
                  }
                  if (document.querySelector('d360-article')) { load(); return; }
                  var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
                        if (document.querySelector('d360-article')) { obs.disconnect(); load(); }
                  });
                  obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
            })();
      </script>

        follow-modal opens. This saves a third-party origin round-trip on every

id="global-custom-css">/*******************************
 ** WOW SITES TEAM
 ** STYLES START
********************************/
:root {
    --color-primary: #3D324A;

    --color-link: #0056E0;
    --color-border: #e0e0e0;

    --color-smoke: #EBEAE1;
    --color-fog: #F4F3EE;
    --color-gray: #6C6862;

    --color-white: #fff;
    --color-dark: #26252A;
}

/*Default*/
.default site-home-page p,
.default site-home-page span,
.default site-home-page a,
.default site-home-page input,
.default site-home-page label,
.default site-home-page li {
    font-weight: 400;
}

.default site-home-page a {
    text-decoration: none;
}

/*Layout*/
.default site-home-page .container,
.default site-home-page site-primary-header-section .nav-bar.primary-nav-bar,
site-home-page .secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar {
    width: 90% !important;
    max-width: 90% !important;
    padding: 0;
    padding-inline: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 auto !important;
}

@media screen and (min-width: 1400px) {

    .default site-home-page .container,
    .default site-home-page site-primary-header-section .nav-bar.primary-nav-bar,
    site-home-page .secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar {
        width: 1280px !important;
        max-width: 1280px !important;
    }
}

@media screen and (max-width: 1366px) {

    .default site-home-page .container,
    .default site-home-page site-primary-header-section .nav-bar.primary-nav-bar,
    site-home-page .secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar {
        width: 85% !important;
        max-width: 85% !important;
    }
}

.section__row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 24px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 1080px) {
    .section__row {
        justify-content: center;
    }
}

@media screen and (max-width: 600px) {
    .section__row {
        flex-direction: column;
    }
}

.col--6 {
    width: calc(66.66% - 18px);
}

.col--5 {
    width: calc(20% - 20px);
}

.col--3 {
    width: calc(33.33% - 16px);
}

.col--2 {
    width: calc(50% - 12px);
}

@media screen and (max-width: 1080px) {

    .column {
        width: calc(50% - 12px);
    }
}

@media screen and (max-width: 600px) {

    .column {
        width: 100%;
    }
}

/*Typography*/
.default site-home-page .heading--section {
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 40px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-dark);
    margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.default site-home-page .heading--sub {
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 28px;
    letter-spacing: -.03px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--color-dark);
    margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.default site-home-page p,
.default site-home-page a,
.default site-home-page span {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 20px;
    letter-spacing: -.06px;
}

.default site-home-page p {
    color: var(--color-dark);
    margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.default site-home-page p:last-child {
    margin: 0;
}

/*Global*/
.default site-home-page header+div {
    min-height: 100vh !important;
}

.default site-home-page figure {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--color-smoke);
}

.default site-home-page section {
    padding: 60px 0;
    overflow: inherit !important;
}

body:has(site-home-page) {
    background: var(--color-fog) !important;
}

/*BUTTON CTA*/
.button--cta {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: var(--color-dark);
    border-radius: 6px;
    transition: transform .2s ease;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
    .button--cta:hover {
        transform: scale(1.05);
    }
}

/*HEADING ICON*/
.heading__icon {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.heading__icon img {
    width: 32px;
    height: auto;
}

.heading__icon .heading--sub {
    padding-left: 16px;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/*Header*/
site-primary-header-section {
    max-height: initial !important;
}

site-home-page site-primary-header-section {
    position: relative;
    background: transparent !important;
}

site-primary-header-section .nav-bar.primary-nav-bar {
    height: auto !important;
    padding-top: 24px !important;
    padding-bottom: 24px !important;
}

.default site-primary-header-section .nav-bar.primary-nav-bar {
    padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

.fluid-layout.default .router-container:has(> site-document) site-primary-header-section .nav-bar.primary-nav-bar {
    padding: 24px !important;
}

site-primary-header-section .nav-bar-brand img {
    width: 52px !important;
    max-width: initial !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: initial !important;
    max-height: initial !important;
}

.nav-bar.primary-nav-bar::after,
.primary-nav-bar-container::after {
    display: none !important;
}

site-primary-header-section ul a,
site-primary-header-section ul a span,
.project-workspace-btn span,
.project-workspace .project-workspace-btn i,
.project-language-btn {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.project-workspace-btn {
    display: none;
}

site-primary-header-section ul li a:hover {
    text-decoration: none !important;
}

header .btn-icon i {
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 30px;
}

header .btn-icon i,
header .btn-icon i.fa-bars {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

header .btn-secondary:hover,
header .btn-secondary.show {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
}

header .divider {
    border-image: 0 !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme] header .secondaryUL .d-block a {
    color: var(--color-dark) !important;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 600px) {
    html[data-bs-theme] header .secondaryUL a {
        color: var(--color-white) !important;
    }

    html[data-bs-theme] header .secondaryUL .d-block a {
        color: var(--color-dark) !important;
    }
}

@media screen and (min-width: 768px) {
    .secondary-nav-bar .scroll-by-button-container {
        justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .secondary-nav-bar .show-menu ul li ul {
        transform: translateX(-150px);
    }
}

/*Banner Section*/
.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section {
    height: auto;
    position: relative;
    padding: 90px 0 175px !important;
    background: transparent !important;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 600px) {
    .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section {
        padding: 60px 0 !important;
    }
}

.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section::before {
    content: "";
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100% + 130px);
    position: absolute;
    top: -130px;
    left: 0;
    z-index: -2;
}

body:has(.workspace__general-support) .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section::before {
    background: #3a3a3c url(https://cdn.us.document360.io/e3a59e39-abd3-4423-964c-0a4008dc5673/Images/Documentation/banner_bg--01.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-20T01%3A39%3A16Z&se=2026-09-20T01%3A49%3A16Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=bcn2wCaCQIkO1oEBWV2Jk2pfsoQQGR0x9tQTffeApw0%3D) no-repeat bottom center;
    background-size: cover;
}

body:has(.workspace__documentation) .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section::before {
    background: var(--color-primary) url(https://cdn.us.document360.io/e3a59e39-abd3-4423-964c-0a4008dc5673/Images/Documentation/banner_bg--02.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-20T01%3A39%3A16Z&se=2026-09-20T01%3A49%3A16Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=bcn2wCaCQIkO1oEBWV2Jk2pfsoQQGR0x9tQTffeApw0%3D) no-repeat center;
    background-size: cover;
}

body:has(.workspace__partners) .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section::before {
    background: var(--color-primary) url(https://cdn.us.document360.io/e3a59e39-abd3-4423-964c-0a4008dc5673/Images/Documentation/banner_bg--03.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-20T01%3A39%3A16Z&se=2026-09-20T01%3A49%3A16Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=bcn2wCaCQIkO1oEBWV2Jk2pfsoQQGR0x9tQTffeApw0%3D) no-repeat center;
    background-size: cover;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 900px) {
    .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section::before {
        background-position: top left;
    }
}

.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section h1,
.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .text-area {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
    width: 50%;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 820px) {

    .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section h1,
    .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .text-area {
        width: 100%;
    }
}

.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section h1 {
    font-size: 44px;
    line-height: 40px;
    margin: 0 0 24px !important;
}

.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .text-area {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 0 38px !important;
}

.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .center h1,
.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .center .text-area {
    margin-right: auto !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
}

.default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .search-box {
    width: 40% !important;
    padding: 0 6px 0 12px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    background: var(--color-fog) !important;
    border-color: var(--color-fog) !important;
    border-radius: 6px !important;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 820px) {
    .default site-home-page site-hero-section .hero-section .search-box {
        width: 100% !important;
    }
}

/*Callout Section*/
section.callout .heading--section {
    margin: 0 0 40px;
}

section.callout .column {
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25);
    overflow: hidden;
}

section.callout figure {
    width: 100%;
    height: 197px;
}

section.callout figure img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

section.callout .content__block {
    padding: 24px 24px 20px;
}

/*Categories Section*/
section.categories {
    background: var(--color-smoke);
}

section.categories .text-center {
    margin-bottom: 48px;
}

section.categories .heading--section {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
}

section.categories .column {
    padding: 24px;
    background: var(--color-white);
    border-top: 3px solid;
    transition: transform .2s ease;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
    section.categories .column:hover {
        transform: scale(1.05);
    }
}

section.categories .article--item {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    padding-right: 40px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}

section.categories .article--item:last-child {
    padding-bottom: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

section.categories .article--item::before {
    content: "\f105";
    font-family: "Font Awesome 5 Pro";
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--color-dark);
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: 0;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
}

section.categories .article--item:not(:last-child)::after {
    content: "";
    width: 50%;
    height: 1px;
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--color-smoke);
}

section.categories .heading--article {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-dark);
    margin: 0 0 4px;
}

section.categories p {
    color: var(--color-gray);
}

/*Categories New Design*/
section.categories .col--5 .heading__icon {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

section.categories .col--5 .heading--sub {
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

section.categories .col--5 .heading__icon img {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    object-fit: contain;
}

/*Visual Section*/
section.visual p {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
}

@media screen and (min-width: 601px) {
    section.visual .col--2:last-child {
        padding-left: 90px;
    }
}

/*Contact Section*/
section.contact-us .section__row {
    padding: 60px;
    background: var(--color-white);
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25);
}

@media screen and (max-width: 600px) {
    section.contact-us .section__row {
        padding: 32px;
    }

    section.contact-us .section__row .column:not(:last-child) {
        padding-bottom: 24px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-smoke);
    }
}

@media screen and (min-width: 1200px) {
    section.contact-us .section__row .column:nth-child(2) {
        border-left: 1px solid var(--color-smoke);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--color-smoke);
    }
}

section.contact-us img {
    width: auto;
    height: 56px;
    margin: 0 0 8px;
}

section.contact-us p,
section.contact-us a {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
}

section.contact-us a {
    display: block;
    color: var(--color-link);
    margin: 0 0 8px;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
    section.contact-us a:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
    }
}

section.contact-us p {
    color: var(--color-gray);
}

/*Support Section*/
section.support__block {
    background: #1D898A url(https://cdn.us.document360.io/e3a59e39-abd3-4423-964c-0a4008dc5673/Images/Documentation/support_bg.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-20T01%3A39%3A16Z&se=2026-09-20T01%3A49%3A16Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=bcn2wCaCQIkO1oEBWV2Jk2pfsoQQGR0x9tQTffeApw0%3D) no-repeat center;
    background-size: cover;
}

body:has(.workspace__partners) section.support__block {
    background: #1D898A url(https://cdn.us.document360.io/e3a59e39-abd3-4423-964c-0a4008dc5673/Images/Documentation/support_bg--03.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-20T01%3A39%3A16Z&se=2026-09-20T01%3A49%3A16Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=bcn2wCaCQIkO1oEBWV2Jk2pfsoQQGR0x9tQTffeApw0%3D) no-repeat center;
    background-size: cover;
}

section.support__block .heading--section,
section.support__block p {
    color: var(--color-white);
}

section.support__block .button--cta {
    margin-top: 32px;
}

/*Footer*/
.footer__custom {
    padding: 32px 0;
    background: #3A3A3C;
}

.footer__custom .logo__block {
    width: calc(28% - 24px);
}

.footer__custom .nav__block {
    width: calc(72% - 24px);
}

@media screen and (max-width: 1080px) {

    .footer__custom .logo__block,
    .footer__custom .nav__block {
        width: 100% !important;
    }
}

.footer__custom .footer--logo {
    width: 55px;
    height: auto;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
}

@media screen and (min-width: 601px) {
    .col--6 .col--3:not(:last-child) {
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .25);
    }
}

.footer__custom p,
.footer__custom a {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
    .footer__custom a:hover {
        text-decoration: underline !important;
    }
}

.footer__custom h5 {
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 28px;
    color: var(--color-white);
    margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.footer__custom a {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

/*Login Links - POC*/
header .secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar {
    background: #3d324a !important;
    border: 0 !important;
}

header .secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar a {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

site-home-page .secondary-nav-bar-container,
site-home-page .secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar {
    background: transparent !important;
}

/*Default Login Button*/
.nav-profile.ms-3 .btn-link {
    display: none;
}

/*******************************
 ** WOW SITES TEAM
 ** STYLES END
********************************/

/**********************
** Articles Page Start
**********************/

/*Default*/
.attachments-list ul li .file-type::before {
    font-family: 'Font Awesome 5 Pro';
}

/*Breadcrumbs*/
.secondary-nav-bar-container .nav-bar.secondary-nav-bar {
    border: 1px solid #e9e9ea !important;
    border-left: 0 !important;
    border-right: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
}

.secondary-nav-bar-container {
    border: 0 !important;
}

.breadcrumb-nav ul li a,
.breadcrumb-nav ul li span {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: var(--color-dark) !important;
}

.breadcrumb-nav ul li span {
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.breadcrumb-nav ul li:before {
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    color: #626469 !important;
}

.sticky-top .progress-container .progress-bar {
    background: #1ca8dd !important;
}

.sticky-top .sticky-content .sticky-content-left .sticky-article-title .article-title {
    font-size: 20px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.breadcrumb-nav ul li::before {
    font-family: "Font Awesome 6 Pro" !important;
}

/*Category Tree*/
.left-container .search-box-container {
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.left-container .search-box {
    background: #f4f6f8 !important;
    border: 1px solid #e9e9ea !important;
    border-radius: 5px !important;
}

.left-container .search-box .shortcut-text {
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 16px !important;
    height: inherit !important;
    padding: 3px !important;
    background: #fff !important;
    border-color: #d2d3d4 !important;
}

.left-container .search-box .search-icon .search-placeholder {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
    color: #626469 !important;
}

.left-container .search-box .search-icon i {
    color: #000;
}

.tree-wrapper .data-title {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #1f2229 !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .tree-wrapper .data-title {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.tree-wrapper .tree-arrow:has(.fa-angle-down) {
    background: #f3fafd;
}

.tree-wrapper .tree-arrow .fa-angle-down {
    color: #1ca8dd;
}

.tree-wrapper.default-category .data-title:hover {
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.tree-active-circle.ps-2,
.tree-wrapper.active .data-title {
    color: #1ca8dd !important;
}

.tree-wrapper.active .data-title {
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.tree-wrapper.active.highlight {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    border-left: 0 solid #1ca8dd !important;
}

/*Main Content*/

/*Global*/
.main-content p,
.main-content a,
.main-content span,
.main-content li {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.main-content p b,
.main-content p strong,
.main-content a b,
.main-content a strong {
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.main-content li p {
    margin: 0 !important;
}

.main-content span[data-glossary] {
    color: #1ca8dd !important;
    border: 0 !important;
}

.main-content span[data-glossary]:hover {
    color: #0779a5 !important;
    text-decoration: underline dotted !important;
    text-underline-offset: 2px !important;
}

.main-content u {
    text-decoration: underline dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 2px;
}

/*Article Heading*/
.main-content h1.article-title {
    font-size: 32px !important;
    line-height: 40px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #1f2229 !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h1.article-title {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.article-info-top li,
.article-right-actions button {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
}

.article-right-actions button {
    color: #1f2229 !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .article-right-actions button {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.article-info .article-info-bottom {
    border-color: #e9e9ea !important;
}

span.article-status-indicators,
span.article-status-indicator {
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    transform: translateY(2px);
}

.category-index-page span.article-status-indicator {
    transform: translateY(0);
}

.contributor-image span {
    font-size: 12px !important;
    line-height: 12px !important;
}

/*Headings*/
.main-content h2+hr,
.main-content h3+hr,
.main-content h4+hr {
    display: none !important;
}

.main-content h2,
.main-content h2 span,
.main-content h3,
.main-content h3 span,
.main-content h4,
.main-content h4 span {
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #1f2229 !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h2,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h2 span,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h3,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h3 span,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h4,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .main-content h4 span {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.main-content h3,
.main-content h3 span {
    font-size: 24px !important;
    line-height: 32px !important;
}

.main-content h4,
.main-content h4 span {
    font-size: 20px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
}

/*Links*/
.main-content a,
.main-content table td p a span {
    color: #1ca8dd !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}

.main-content a i {
    padding-left: 4px;
}

.main-content a:hover,
.main-content table td p a:hover span {
    color: #0779a5 !important;
    text-decoration: underline dotted !important;
    text-underline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/*Bullet Lists*/
html[data-bs-theme] body[dir] #main-content ul li[data-block-id] p,
html[data-bs-theme] body[dir] #articleContent ol li[data-block-id] p {
    padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 0 12px !important;
}

/*Code Block*/
.main-content pre[class*="language-"] {
    background: transparent !important;
    border-color: #e9e9ea !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
}

.main-content div.code-toolbar>.toolbar {
    background: #f8f8f9 !important;
    border: 0 !important;
}

.main-content div.code-toolbar>.toolbar .toolbar-item:first-child span {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    text-transform: lowercase !important;
}

.main-content div.code-toolbar>.toolbar .toolbar-item:last-child span {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    text-transform: capitalize !important;
}

.main-content code,
.main-content code[class*="language-"],
.main-content code[class*="language-"] span {
    font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, Adwaita Mono, Liberation Mono,
        Lucida Console, monospace !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.main-content .token.selector,
.main-content .token.attr-name,
.main-content .token.string,
.main-content .token.char,
.main-content .token.builtin,
.main-content .token.inserted {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
}

/*Accordion*/
.main-content .details-wrapper {
    padding: 16px 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e9e9ea !important;
}

.main-content .details-wrapper details {
    padding: 0 !important;
    border: none !important;
}

.main-content summary {
    min-height: 2px !important;
    padding: 0 0 0 32px !important;
}

.main-content summary p,
.main-content summary p span,
.main-content summary h2,
.main-content summary h2 span,
.main-content summary h3,
.main-content summary h3 span,
.main-content summary h4,
.main-content summary h4 span {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}

.main-content summary p:empty {
    display: none !important;
}

.main-content .details-wrapper details:not([data-button-align="left"])+.details-arrow {
    top: 12px !important;
    right: auto !important;
    left: 6px !important;
    transform: rotate(90deg) !important;
    transition: unset !important;
}

.main-content .details-wrapper details[open]+.details-arrow {
    transform: rotate(180deg) !important;
}

.main-content .details-wrapper details:not([data-button-align="left"])+.details-arrow::before {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    color: #626469 !important;
}

.main-content .details-wrapper details[open]+.details-arrow::before {
    color: #1ca8dd !important;
}

.main-content .details-wrapper details[open]+.details-arrow::after {
    content: "";
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    transform: translate(-6px, 4px);
    background: #f3fafd;
    border-radius: 4px;
    z-index: -1;
}

#articleContent img {
    margin: 8px;
}

.main-content p:has(:only-child):has(> img) {
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/*Article Feedbacks*/
.article-feedback div,
.article-feedback button,
.article-feedback i {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
}

.article-feedback div {
    color: #626469 !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .article-feedback div {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.article-feedback button {
    color: #1f2229 !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
    padding: 8px 12px !important;
    border-color: #d2d3d4 !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .article-feedback button {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

/*Article Pagination*/
.article-navigation.mb-3.justify-content-start {
    justify-content: center !important;
    gap: 16px;
}

.article-navigation button {
    background: #f8f8f9 !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    border: none !important;
}

.article-navigation-des {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #626469 !important;
}

.article-navigation-des+div {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #1f2229 !important;
    white-space: unset !important;
    overflow: auto !important;
}

.article-navigation i {
    color: var(--color-dark);
}

/*TOC*/
d360-table-of-content .section-title {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    text-transform: unset !important;
    color: #626469 !important;
    margin: 0 0 8px !important;
}

d360-table-of-content .list-unstyled {
    gap: 0 !important;
}

.toc-accordion ul li a {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 26px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #1f2229 !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .toc-accordion ul li a {
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="light"] .toc-accordion li:has(> .toc-item.selected),
html[data-bs-theme="light"] .toc-accordion li:hover {
    background: #f8f8f9 !important;
}

.toc-accordion li:has(> .toc-item.selected) {
    border-left: 2px solid #1ca8dd;
}

.toc-accordion li:has(> .toc-item.selected) a {
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.toc-accordion li:has(> .toc-item.selected) a::before {
    display: none !important;
}

/*Article Summary*/
d360-article-summary button[aria-label="Article summary"] span.fw-bold {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #1f2229 !important;
}

#main-content .related-articles-title {
    font-size: 20px !important;
    line-height: 24px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    padding: 12px 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

#main-content h2 {
    margin-top: 8px !important;
}

#main-content img {
    margin-top: 16px !important;
}

h2 span#blockvariable {
    font-size: 28px !important;
}

/**********************
** Articles Page End
**********************/

/* ===================================================
   1. MAIN ARTICLE LINK STATE OVERRIDES (.main-content)
   =================================================== */

/* Target links in main-content, BUT EXCLUDE breadcrumbs AND related articles */
.main-content a:not(.breadcrumb-nav *):not(.breadcrumb-overflow *):not(.related-articles-container *):link,
.main-content a:not(.breadcrumb-nav *):not(.breadcrumb-overflow *):not(.related-articles-container *) {
    color: #0F5C5A !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/* Visited Main Links */
.main-content a:not(.breadcrumb-nav *):not(.breadcrumb-overflow *):not(.related-articles-container *):visited {
    color: #0F3935 !important;
}

/* Hover Main Links */
.main-content a:not(.breadcrumb-nav *):not(.breadcrumb-overflow *):not(.related-articles-container *):hover {
    color: #0F3935 !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/* Active Main Links */
.main-content a:not(.breadcrumb-nav *):not(.breadcrumb-overflow *):not(.related-articles-container *):active {
    color: #0F5C5A !important;
}

/* ===================================================
   2. BREADCRUMB SPECIFIC OVERRIDES 
   =================================================== */
body .main-content .breadcrumb-nav ul li a,
body .main-content .breadcrumb-overflow ul li a {
    color: #26252A !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}

body .main-content .breadcrumb-nav ul li a:hover,
body .main-content .breadcrumb-overflow ul li a:hover {
    color: #0F3935 !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
}

body .main-content .breadcrumb-nav ul li span,
body .main-content .breadcrumb-overflow ul li span {
    color: #26252A !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

/* ===================================================
   3. RELATED ARTICLES SPECIFIC OVERRIDES
   =================================================== */

/* Default state for your related articles links */

#main-content h2 {
    margin-top: 32px !important;
}

/* ===================================================
   DOCUMENTATION WORKSPACE ONLY: REMOVE MOBILE HERO IMAGE
   =================================================== */

@media screen and (max-width: 820px) {

    /* 1. Target ::before and ::after pseudo-elements inside documentation workspace */
    body.workspace__documentation [class*="hero-section"]::before,
    body.workspace__documentation [class*="hero-section"]::after,
    body.workspace__documentation [class*="site-hero"]::before,
    body.workspace__documentation [class*="site-hero"]::after,
    body:has(.workspace__documentation) [class*="hero-section"]::before,
    body:has(.workspace__documentation) [class*="hero-section"]::after {
        background: #433950 !important;
        background-image: none !important;
    }
}

/* ===================================================
   MOBILE (320PX & UP TO 480PX): HERO H1 FONT SIZE 40PX
   =================================================== */

@media screen and (max-width: 480px) {

    /* 1. Attribute wildcard match (Bypasses missing dots & exact class chains) */
    body.workspace__documentation [class*="hero-section"] h1,
    body:has(.workspace__documentation) [class*="hero-section"] h1,
    /* 2. Direct selector fallback */
    .default.site-home-page.site-hero-section .hero-section h1,
    .default .site-home-page .site-hero-section .hero-section h1,
    .hero-section h1 {
        font-size: 36px !important;
        line-height: 1.2 !important;
        /* Prevents text lines from overlapping */
        color: red !important;
    }
}

/* ===================================================
   image changes
   =================================================== */

#main-content img {
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin-top: 2px !important;
}

#articleContent img {
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 2px 4px !important;
}

/* ===================================================
   PROGRESS BAR COLOR OVERRIDE
   =================================================== */

.sticky-top .progress-container .progress-bar {
    background-color: #06888A !important;
    /* Replace #007bff with your desired color hex or name */
    background: #06888A !important;
    /* Ensures gradient or shorthand background properties are overridden */
